possible_label_zh: Possible：可能肺部相關，低信心；肺炎歸因尚未確認
unknown_label_zh: CMV已檢出；肺部致病意義未知，供醫師覆核
constraints: Possible is a research reporting category, not clinical probable/proven CMV pneumonia.
An independent, exact-identity, event-aligned respiratory detection can support a low-confidence Possible together with credible mNGS detection.
Assay independence may be explicitly user-confirmed, but the assay name, qPCR method, units and viral activity are not inferred.
Rank, reads, RPM, molecule combinations and fixed technical test counts are not disease gates.
Missing hospital confirmation does not erase the candidate or imply negativity; it leaves the etiologic interpretation unknown unless another accepted attribution path is available.
Blood-only corroboration is not a pulmonary Possible path.
Other pathogens never automatically veto an independently supported CMV candidate; co-detection is not automatically confirmed co-infection.
Activity and organ-attribution axes remain separate from reporting. This route does not manufacture an O2/O3 or A1/A2 claim.
Reviewed lung-specific attribution paths remain available without minimum rank or technical test count requirements.
Fallback alone does not establish pulmonary positivity. Keep detection visible with unknown significance.
Explicit resolved/asymptomatic-shedding evidence conflicts with automatic etiologic selection and requires review.
No benchmark answer or patient identifier is used by the decision function. Apply identically to all CMV candidates.
